Voter ID

PAN Card

Aadhaar (A4 printed version with verified signature, not just the smart card)

Original passport + photocopies of first and last two pages
All self attested..
They only asked me for the Voter ID & my passport during the process. No one asked for DigiLocker or any digital documents.
